question: At matched charged node work on two known restricted river spots, does replacing B4 external-sampling passes with full-tree expected passes under the same signed linear update reduce medium/dry exploitability without degrading low/wet?
spot_selection: Exactly the already inspected new_low_wet_ip and new_medium_dry_oop from the frozen PR #98 cohort; medium/dry is the known failure and low/wet is the known nondegradation check. No spot is unseen or selected after new candidate outcomes.

control.traversal: IID external sampling, batch size four

candidate.traversal: complete expected_pass for target 0 then target 1
candidate.warm_start: same exact simultaneous uniform expectation charged as two complete tree traversals
candidate.rng: explicit PCG64(0) object required by ControlledTrainer; full traversal must consume zero random draws and its state must remain unchanged

crossing: first complete target-0 then target-1 iteration at or above each charged node-work label; every full pass charges all tree nodes including terminal/chance/zero-reach; retain overshoot
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 exploitability divided by initial pot, lower is better
contrast: one deterministic candidate score minus each of the three immutable B4 seed scores at every checkpoint; report all three contrasts and their median, explicitly dependent because candidate is shared

decision.positive: both deterministic candidate spot scores pass unchanged absolute gates; final medium/dry candidate minus B4 control median <= -0.001 initial pots; final low/wet candidate minus B4 control median <= +0.001
decision.negative: candidate fails any absolute gate, final medium/dry candidate minus B4 control median >= +0.001, or final low/wet candidate minus B4 control median > +0.001
decision.inconclusive: other complete outcome; any failed source, compute, numerical or publication gate stops with retained evidence

diagnostics: both-seat additive saved-prefix best-response gain at prespecified medium/dry exact turn rows 2443/1596/14 and river rows 1806/640, plus whole turn/river totals, all checkpoints; report board/hole/actions/probabilities/reach/conditional alternative-action values with fixed saved opponent and optimal reply continuation assumptions; diagnostic only
other_metrics: information rows and actual trainable table bytes
whole-path wall seconds and peak worker resident bytes

profile.forecast: for each game take the maximum of three complete construction-through-replay whole times multiplied by 10m/actual final charged work; T is the sum of the two maxima for the serial candidate run; require strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200

reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 comparison-only scalar audit after complete candidate own policies are published and GitHub-byte-verified; immutable B4 prior audit reused; no reference strategy enters training
publication: publish this protocol before any candidate proof/profile/score; isolated tested source with exact-source base/optional/hooks/hosted checks; publish and byte-verify fictional proof, all six 1m profiles and separate conservative admission before one two-path own run; publish own raw policies before reference audit; final report-head checks, solo review and history-preserving merge
stop_rule: one deterministic full-expectation candidate path per known spot; retain complete, partial and failed results; no B8 retry, new seeds, extra candidate path, changed spot, budget extension, threshold change or default promotion from this experiment
